name: Compute Cluster S44: Z-Score Quintile Trap
description: Tests: z-score thresholds assume normality but financial data has fat tails. WRONG: zscore < -0.84 as quintile proxy (unequal populations). CORRECT: percentrank for equal-population buckets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S44: Z-Score Quintile Trap
# =============================================================================
# S44 rule: Z-score thresholds (z < -0.84 etc.) assume normality.
# Financial data has fat tails → unequal bucket populations.
#   WRONG:   conditional_select(zscore < -0.84, 1, zscore < -0.25, 2, ...)
#   CORRECT: percentrank → conditional_select(pctrank <= 20, 1, ...)
# Z-scores = distance from mean (signal strength).
# percentrank = ordinal rank (equal bucketing).

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === Z-score of returns ===
z_ret = zscore(window=252)(rets)

# === WRONG: Z-score thresholds as quintile proxy ===
quintile_wrong = conditional_select(
    z_ret < -0.84, 1.0,
    conditional_select(
        z_ret < -0.25, 2.0,
        conditional_select(
            z_ret < 0.25, 3.0,
            conditional_select(
                z_ret < 0.84, 4.0,
                5.0
            )
        )
    )
)

# === CORRECT: Percentrank for equal-population buckets ===
pctrank = percentrank(rets, 252)
quintile_correct = conditional_select(
    pctrank <= 20, 1.0,
    conditional_select(
        pctrank <= 40, 2.0,
        conditional_select(
            pctrank <= 60, 3.0,
            conditional_select(
                pctrank <= 80, 4.0,
                5.0
            )
        )
    )
)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Z-Score of Returns (252d)',
    category='Z-Score',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.84, title='+0.84', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.84, title='-0.84', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero')
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=z_ret)

xy_lines(
    title='WRONG Quintile (z-score thresholds — unequal populations)',
    category='Quintile Comparison',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Quintile', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=quintile_wrong)

xy_lines(
    title='CORRECT Quintile (percentrank — equal populations)',
    category='Quintile Comparison',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Pctrank Quintile', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=quintile_correct)

histogram(
    title='Distribution: Z-Score Quintiles (should be unequal)',
    category='Quintile Distribution',
    bins=5
)(quintile_wrong)

histogram(
    title='Distribution: Percentrank Quintiles (should be equal)',
    category='Quintile Distribution',
    bins=5
)(quintile_correct)
